{{Top|leg}}
'''Under the Table''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Point Nadir]]. It was frequented by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], shipjackers, and shady merchants. It was often used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to find new another load after they finished a cargo run. It was also a place where a person could find a ride or hire a ship for a quick and discreet escape from Point Nadir.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
